content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: For overall conduct, coordination & supervision of all research activities. He/ she will demonstrate leadership role and develop support mechanisms for good clinical practices. He/ she will be responsible for recruitment of participants, implementation phase and training programmes for all the stakeholders. Coordinating patient transportation to AIIMS Jodhpur and assisting with investigations and hospital procedures. Coordinating intervention initiation as per protocol, including procurement, inventory, and storage of study medications. Maintaining records, data entry and statistical analysis, report writing and budget management, coordinating staff/doctor training and imaging investigations and performing other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled application in the prescribed format. Bio-data. All relevant original documents. One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience. "No Objection Certificate" (for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking).

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reporting time for the candidates starts at 09:00 AM on 4/11/2026 and the closing time to report for the interview is 10:00 AM on the same day, after which no additional candidates would be entertained for the interview. The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants. Candidates should appear in person for Walk-In-Interview.
